rows.en: Where... am I...? Someone... Someone's calling me?
Who...? That familiar voice... Oh, right... It's Mom...
I came to the airport lobby to meet Mom and Dad
when they got back, didn't I? But... why is it so dark?
...Oh, right. It was nighttime.
No... That's strange.
Even at night, the lobby shouldn't be pitch-black...
Oh, Mom's back. Dad's with her too.
They walk toward me, waving.
I always tell them to stop because it's embarrassing...
Even in all this darkness, I can see the two of them clearly.
!? Suddenly, a tightness grips my chest.
What...? What is this horrible feeling...?
Neither of them notices what's happening to me.
They walk slowly toward me, as if drifting through water...
The horrible feeling swells inside me.
No... No, no, no!!
You can't stay there! Neither of you!!
I can't take it anymore. I try to shout.
But no sound comes out.
It's as if I've swallowed some huge lump
that's pressing against my throat...
As if something has shoved me forward,
I break into a run toward them.
But just like moving through water, something thick and sticky
clings to my body.
It drags against my body. I can't move the way I want to.
At this rate, I won't make it!
I won't make it... in time for what?
What's about to happen?
I know... I should know, but...
I don't...
The horrible feeling reaches its peak.
They're right in front of me now.
Close enough to touch if I reach out.
There... Just a little farther... Just a little...
Ahh!
A flash of light burns my retinas...
The world is swallowed by darkness again...
But... I can feel something... in my hands...
Something warm...
Something... that doesn't move.
Something warm is sticking to my hands too...
The smell of iron...
<FC:78:3E>No... I can't open my eyes...
<FC:78:3E>I can't look...
<FC:78:3E>There...
<FC:78:3E>All around me...
Touya: "Aaaaaaaaah!"
Ymir: "A-are you all right?"
Touya: "Wh-where am I...?"
Ai: "Are you still half asleep?
You're in the treatment room, obviously."
Touya: "Oh..."
Ai: "Anyway, you're drenched in sweat.
Did you have a bad dream or something?"
Touya: "...It's nothing."
Ai: "Hey! What's with that attitude?!
I heard you'd collapsed, so I came because I was worried!
Well, I'll let it slide just this once."
Arthur: "Ai, is that what you came here to say?"
Ai: "Ugh..."
Ymir: "Come on. There's something you want to say, isn't there?"
Ai: "U-um... Well... I'm sorry!
I wanted to apologize properly again..."
Touya: "...Why do you feel so responsible...?"
Ai: "Because... you said Yamato was your family..."
Touya: "Yeah, she is, but..."
Ai: "And... well... she's the only family you have..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "I'm sorry... About your parents...
I told Ai..."
Touya: "...I see...
So you've been looking into that sort of thing too..."
Ymir: "...I'm sorry."
Touya: "Well, it's all right.
My parents were caught in a terrorist bombing and killed.
That's a fact..."
Ai: "Actually, it happened to me too...
My parents were at that airport too..."
Touya: "Huh...? You too?"
Ai: "Yeah. So when you say Yamato's
your 'family'... I know how you feel..."
Touya: "I... see. I'm sorry.
Is your hand all right?"
Ai: "Huh? Y-yeah."
Touya: "Okay... Good."
Ai: "...Yeah."
Gabon: "Oh, looks like you're awake.
Your 'Adjuster' seems to be working
properly too, so there's nothing to worry about now.
See? Even that cut on your cheek has healed."
Touya: "...Oh, you're right."
Gabon: "And your 'family' is safe too."
Touya: "Sh-she is...? Sorry for the trouble.
...Thank you."
???: "Well, look at you being nyice and honest for once.
If only you were always like that."
Touya: "Huh...?"
???: "What are you looking around for?
Have you forgotten my face? How heartless."
Touya: "Huh?! No... But... It can't be..."
???: "Come on, Touya. Get a grip.
It's me. Yamato."
Touya: "Wh... You... You can talk?!"
Yamato: "To be precise, I can talk nyow."
Touya: "What... do you mean?"
Gabon: "I implanted a cortical nanocom.
Now Yamato can say whatever's on her mind."
Touya: "A nanocom...? Hey..."
Gabon: "Gah ha ha! No need to thank me!"
Touya: "That's not what I meant! Why'd you go and do that without asking..."
Ymir: "Please calm down. Aren't you happy
that Yamato can talk?"
Touya: "Huh...? Hmm... Yamato,
are you all right with this?"
Yamato: "...Well, sure, I was a little panicked at first, but...
I think this is nyot so bad.
Besides... I'm happy I can talk with you, Touya."
Touya: "O-oh. Well, I guess it's all right, then.
Gabon did save your life, after all."
Gabon: "Right. Next time, I'll add even more 'great' features..."
Touya: "This time only!
Don't you do anything else without asking, got it?!"
Gabon: "Now, don't be so bashful."
Touya: "H-hey, listen!"
Clovis: "Hey! Feeling bett...!!"
Touya: "...What's wrong?"
Clovis: "C-c-c-c-c-c-c... A cat...!"
Yamato: "Is there something wrong with me?"
Clovis: "Eeeeeek! A monster caaaaat!"
Yamato: "Calling a beauty like me a monster cat... That's nyot very nice!"
Ai: "Hey, Arthur. Is Clovis scared of cats?"
Arthur: "It seems so.
I don't know the details myself, but apparently, when he was a child,
something terrible may or may not have happened to him..."
Ai: "Hmm..."
Ymir: "How are you feeling?"
Touya: "Oh, yeah...
I'm a little dizzy, but I'm all right."
Ymir: "...I'm glad."
Arthur: "Ymir, it's nearly time."
Ymir: "Hm? Oh, that's right..."
Touya: "Is something happening?"
Ymir: "Yes. Prince Lodis, Celica and the others
are returning home."
Touya: "Home? You mean that Kingdom of Agarthia place?"
Ymir: "Yes. Come to think of it, Touya, you still
haven't met Lady Alforina, have you?
Would you like to come along?"
Touya: "Sure. If that's all right with you."
Ymir: "Of course. Shall we go, then?"
Gabon: "I'll head over to that place ahead of you.
See you later."
Ymir: "All right. Take care."
Gabon: "See you."
Alforina: "Touya, thank you for yesterday.
Without you, things might have been disastrous.
Thanks to everyone's efforts, the damage was kept to a minimum.
On everyone's behalf, I offer you my thanks. Thank you."
Touya: "Oh, you're..."
Alforina: "My name is Alforina El Istarsh.
I may not look it, but I am currently the queen."
Touya: "The queen..."
Alforina: "Yes. You collapsed so suddenly last night
that you gave me quite a fright. Are you feeling all right now?"
Touya: "Y-yeah."
Alforina: "I'm glad to hear it."
Yamato: "I'm feeling fine too!"
Alforina: "You seem quite recovered now.
Oh, yes. Here's a little gift from me to celebrate."
Alforina: "...There we are.
Yes, it suits you very well."
Yamato: "Thank you, Princess!"
Alforina: "Hee hee. You're very welcome."
????: "So you were the one piloting Zeifon then...
I can hardly believe it was your first time.
It seems your ability to adapt really is different from that of people in this world."
Touya: "...And you are?"
????: "Forgive my late introduction.
I am Tyron Ren Arsdaluar.
Her Majesty has bestowed the title of knight upon me.
It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance."
Ymir: "Tyron is one of the finest
swordsmen on the continent."
Tyron: "Oh, no, I'm hardly that impressive."
Touya: "Knights, huh...? For a place with robots and all,
it sure feels old-fashioned around here."
Ai: "Right? Right?
I was surprised at first too."
Alforina: "York in particular has many old customs,
so that tendency is especially strong here."
Ai: "Hm? That pendant..."
Alforina: "Hm? Oh, this...? Well..."
Ai: "Oh, I get it! That's from Lodis, isn't it?"
Ai: "I'm so jealous! So jealous! I wish I..."
Tyron: "...Ahem!"
Clovis: "Speak of the..."
Lodis: "Hm? Is something wrong?"
Ai: "I heard! You're quite the thoughtful one, aren't you?"
Ymir: "H-hey, Ai!"
Lodis: "What are you talking about?"
Ai: "Oh, don't play dumb!
You know. Alforina's pendant.
Just what I'd expect from Agarthia's proud playboy.
You never overlook a detail like that."
Alforina: "...Is that so?"
Lodis: "Wh... N-no, it isn't...
Ai! What are you saying...?"
Alforina: "Hee hee hee. I'm only joking.
I'm well aware of your popularity with the ladies, Lord Lodis."
Ai: "Somehow, I feel like I'm watching a pair of lovebirds."
Tix: "...It suits you very well."
Alforina: "Thank you.
And thank you for the lovely ring too, Lord Tix.
I shall take very good care of it."
Tix: "In safekeeping, you mean...? Lady Alforina, you seem to prefer
my brother's gift."
Celica: "Tix?!"
Alforina: "It was such an expensive gift, far more than I deserve at present...
I apologize if I have offended you."
Tix: "No, that wasn't what I meant..."
Lodis: "Please forgive him.
Tix has reached that age, you see...
It's only natural for him to take an interest in girls."
Tix: "B-Brother?!"
Alforina: "?"
Celica: "Brother, it's nearly time..."
Alforina: "Is it time for you to depart already?"
Lodis: "Yes. It pains me to leave you
at a time like this, but..."
Fain: "Then let's stay!
Our kingdom of Agarthia and York are allies.
To return home knowing that our ally is in danger..."
Celica: "I understand how you feel,
but officially, we're here in York to study.
Lodis and Tix have been treated as temporary envoys,
which is how we've managed to stay this long. Ignoring an order from home
to return would be going too far."
Fain: "But..."
Alforina: "We shall be all right. Besides, Zigrim's acts of intimidation
are nothing new.
They're rather like an epidemic."
Tyron: "Besides, tying Lord Lodis's hands here
would do nothing to advance our common goal.
Lord Garyud and Ciel are at the border, after all.
There's no need to worry. Or is their presence not enough to reassure you?"
Fain: "O-of course it is!
As the Sword Radiance, Phantom Saint,
Lord Garyud is defending that fort.
There's no way the likes of Zigrim could bring it down!"
Tyron: "Then you can return home with an easy mind."
Fain: "Y-yes..."
Lodis: "Then I'll see you next in the Holy Land."
Alforina: "Ah... Lord Lodis."
Lodis: "?"
Alforina: "Might I have a word in your ear...?"
Celica: "Tix..."
Lodis: "Your Majesty..."
Alforina: "It will be all right.
Have a safe journey..."
Lodis: "...Very well.
We shall meet in the Holy Land. I promise."
Celica: "We shall take our leave, then.
See you all later."
Fain: "Touya. Your skill is the real thing.
I'm looking forward to the next time we meet."
Touya: "Well, I'll try not to disappoint you."
Fain: "Good. ...Ymir. Take care."
Ymir: "Hm? Yes.
You take care too, Fain."
Fain: "Yes, ma'am! I'll be going, then!"
Ai: "It's tough being so popular, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Wh-what are you talking about? It's nothing like that.
Besides, he's like a little brother to me..."
Ai: "Hmm. Fain's got a rough road ahead of him..."
Tix: "Lady Alforina... If only I were stronger...
I could be of more help to you..."
Alforina: "Please don't think that.
You've already been a great help, Lord Tix.
We shall be all right.
You must take care of yourself too."
Tix: "Yes... I shall take my leave, then."
Tyron: "I'll go and see them off, then.
Ymir, shall we go?"
Ymir: "Yes."
Touya: "...Hey. What exactly's going on here?"
Alforina: "Hm? Oh, of course.
Do you already know that we are building Spirit Mechs here?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Alforina: "The man who proposed that project was the gentleman you just met...
Prince Lodis, heir to the throne of the Kingdom of Agarthia."
Touya: "Then why do it here in York,
instead of in his own country?"
Alforina: "Actually, the Spirit Mech Development Project nearly won approval
in the League Assembly once, but a struggle for control
caused an uproar, and the matter was ultimately left unresolved."
Touya: "A mess?"
Clovis: "It's the same in any world.
People can still put up with another country coming out ahead,
but they can't stand their own country losing out."
Touya: "So they all kept each other in check
and couldn't reach a decision?"
Alforina: "Yes... Sadly, the passage of a hundred years
seems to have erased the memory of
that dreadful incident."
Touya: "You mean that huge explosion
Forzen was talking about?"
Alforina: "Yes. Its scars now live on only in people's memories,
and the incident is seen as history.
But the scenes preserved on film are
the very image of 'terror.' The shock of that explosion
caused damage on a global scale.
But the real 'terror' was not the explosion itself.
It was the secondary disasters: earthquakes, tsunamis, and the abnormal weather
caused by dust from the explosion.
The dust in particular hid the 'Orb of Light' shining high overhead,
and Agarthia entered a season that,
since the birth of this world, no one had ever experienced:
'winter.'
It took several years before Agarthia
regained its light.
Then it took more than a decade for the environment to recover.
We must never allow such a tragedy to happen again.
Though the whole world should be joining forces,
people seem about to repeat the same mistake again.
We cannot simply stand by and watch.
That is why we offered our cooperation."
Touya: "I don't know how things stand now, but can York
and its supporters really handle this alone?"
Alforina: "I would be lying if I said I had no concerns.
But we cannot move forward unless we start walking,
even if it is only one tiny step..."
Arthur: "Clovis, Ai and I share that ideal,
and that is why we're helping."
Touya: "I..."
Alforina: "You needn't be in such a hurry
to answer. No one is eager to throw themselves
into battle, after all."
Ai: "Hey, ever since yesterday, things around the castle
have seemed pretty hectic. Did something happen?"
Alforina: "There is nothing to worry about.
Everyone is just a little anxious."
Ai: "Well, of course they are. This country's main fighting force
is just four Armored Mechs, and three of them
aren't even here."
Arthur: "Come to think of it, Reduce went to Limberg
as a military adviser, didn't he?"
Clovis: "And old Garyud and Ciel
went to the fort on the front line."
Touya: "But you've got the Spirit Mechs, right?
Let's see... One for each of you three here, and..."
Arthur: "Ai's Vishal, Clovis's Baldock,
my Drydes, and Zeifon. Four in all."
Touya: "Right, exactly."
Alforina: "The Spirit Mechs are certainly powerful.
Yet if we were to use them
as weapons of war,
we would betray the people
who lent us their support. Our true enemy
is 'Ze=Ode.'"
Tyron: "Excuse me!"
Alforina: "Is something wrong?"
Tyron: "Multiple signals believed to be Armored Mechs
have been detected in Glascher Valley.
It is possible that information about the Liebhofen
has been leaked to outsiders."
Touya: "What's this 'Liebhofen' thing?"
Alforina: "It is a mobile fortress built as part of
the Spirit Mech Development Project.
It has already reached the point where it can withstand actual combat,
so if anyone were to seize it, the consequences would be dire."
Ai: "But who would do that?"
Tyron: "Hm? W-well..."
Alforina: "It could be a Zigrim unit.
We have also heard that they are trying to obtain Spirit Mechs
to counter the Kingdom of Agarthia."
Touya: "Isn't Zigrim the country that's gathering troops
at the border right now?"
Ai: "Maybe that army at the border is a diversion,
and this unit is the real attack. That's possible too."
Tyron: "Y-yes, that must be it.
In any case, we need to investigate."
Alforina: "I'm sorry to trouble you, but could I ask you to investigate?"
Arthur: "I don't mind, but..."
Ai: "Hey, what are you going to do?"
Touya: "M-me...?"
Yamato: "You're nyot planning to just stand
around and watch, are you?!"
Touya: "But..."
Yamato: "We should help each other out when there's trouble, right?"
Touya: "I just feel like I'm being dragged along by all this..."
Ai: "Ohhh, I get it. You're not confident, are you?
I understand. It is scary, after all."
Touya: "Wh... What did you say?! All right! I'll go out and
investigate or whatever you want! Right! Let's go!"
Yamato: 'Touya really is...'
Ai: '...so simple-minded.'
Alforina: "Touya.
I sense great strength in you... Please, take this."
Touya: "...What's this?"
Alforina: "It is called a 'Resonance Crystal.'
It's a charm my mother gave me.
I'm sure it will guide you in the right direction."
Touya: "But..."
Alforina: "I have a new charm now, after all."
Ai: "You mean that pendant?"
Alforina: "...Yes."
Clovis: "Man... How can she say something so embarrassing
with a straight face? But she really pulls it off..."
Arthur: "It's a gift she was born with.
Noble people can make almost anything look elegant."
Touya: "But this is so important to you.
A guy like me can't just accept it..."
Alforina: "No. I want you to have it."
Touya: "B-but... When you say it's a keepsake from your mother..."
Ai: "Hey, you!
Are you saying you won't accept Alforina's feelings?!"
Touya: "Shut up! That's a whole different matter!"
Alforina: "It's all right... Really, it's all right..."
Touya: "...All right. But I'm only holding onto it for you.
I'll give it straight back when I return."
Alforina: "Yes. May the wind of hope be with you."
Ai: "Hey, Clovis.
You seem to be handling this pretty well."
Clovis: "W-what are you talking about?"
Ai: "Oh, don't play dumb... Huh? Why are you
staying so far away from Yamato?"
Clovis: "S-shut up!"
Ai: "You really ought to
say a proper hello to your new teammate!"
Clovis: "Waaah! Don't push me! Eeeeeek!!"
Yamato: "I'm nyot going to criticize anyone's tastes, but
I'm nyot sure how I feel about this..."
Touya: "...He really can't handle cats, can he?"
Arthur: "No, he can't."
Ymir: "Did something happen to Clovis?
He jumped into Baldock in quite a hurry..."
Arthur: "Oh, just a little something..."
Ai: "Huh? What are you doing here, Ymir?"
Ymir: "What do you mean? I'm getting ready to leave..."
Arthur: "...Did Tyron
tell you about this, by any chance?"
Ymir: "Y-yes..."
Clovis: "Hey! Let's get going already!"
Ymir: "Y-yes, of course.
I'll be coming along in the landship this time.
I'll be supporting everyone, so let's work together."
Ai: "With support from the Holy Alchemical Society's Chief First-Class Scholar,
we'll be nigh unstoppable!"
Touya: "Whatever, but not even old guys
say things like that these days."
Ai: "Oh, shut up! Anyway, hurry up and
get yourself ready!"
Touya: "Ready...? You mean
I just have to get into that Zeifon?"
Ymir: "Yes. Thank you."
Touya: "No need to thank me.
I can't go back until we figure out what caused this anyway.
And we won't solve anything by sitting around."
Clovis: "That's the spirit."
Arthur: "Well then, shall we get going?"
Tyron: "...Was that all right?"
Alforina: "Yes. We have already done
everything we can. We can safely leave the rest to them now."
Tyron: "Still, it's remarkable that they agreed to go.
When Your Majesty first told me about this,
I honestly worried whether I was up to the task."
Alforina: "My. Even you, Tyron, one of the Three Sword Knights,
can feel that way?
Still, it seems you need a little more practice at acting."
Tyron: "Please don't tease me."
Alforina: "Heh heh..."
Tyron: "...The weather has taken an unfortunate turn."
Alforina: "Yes...
Tyron. You have served me so well all this time.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart."
Tyron: "...Your words honor me."
Alforina: "..."
Tyron: "..."
Alforina: "...This battle looks likely to be a hard one.
I wonder if we shall ever look up at a blue sky again.
Tyron, even you..."
Tyron: "Your Majesty. I had thought that this life of mine
was yours from the day I swore that oath."
Alforina: "...Yes. Of course.
Forgive me. That was unnecessary."
Alforina: "...I hope the rain stops soon."
Ai: "Hey, how come only Clovis and Arthur
get to ride on the ship? Let me aboard too!"
Touya: "...What are you, a kid? Where exactly do you see
enough room on that thing for our mechs?"
Arthur: "Besides, my mech and Clovis's
can't move very quickly."
Clovis: "And this landship seems pretty fast,
so this is the best way to travel."
Ai: "What's with that tone?! Keep talking like that
and I'll put Yamato in your cockpit!"
Clovis: "!!"
Arthur: "Ai... You're pushing this a little too far."
Ai: "Aww..."
Arthur: "...Ai."
Ai: "...Okaaay."
Touya: "...Sheesh. What are you even... Hm?"
Yamato: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Hey, Yamato. What's this dot?"
Yamato: "Oh! That's a Pranya reading!
It must be the ones Tyron was talking about!"
Ymir: "Hm? I'm not seeing anything here...
Please send me the data for now!"
Touya: "Hm? L-like this...?"
Ymir: "Let's see..."
Ai: "Oh! I've picked them up too!"
Ymir: "This is... Yes, they're Zigrim Republic machines.
But that's odd... There's no matching data for the unit they belong to...
This violates the International League Treaty..."
Ai: "What's that treaty?"
Ymir: "It's an agreement to disclose information on military capabilities.
War couldn't be eliminated, but the agreement was established so countries could
monitor each other and curb warfare.
Violating it is the same as making enemies of every country,
and yet..."
Touya: "Anyway, they're heading toward us,
right?"
Ymir: "Yes. But why are they coming this way
instead of heading for the Liebhofen...?"
Arthur: "Since we don't know who they are, we should
avoid an unnecessary battle. If we're careless, we could give Zigrim
an excuse to declare war."
Clovis: "I agree with Arthur.
Besides, if this is a Zigrim unit heading for the castle,
there's no way they're alone. There must be a main force.
In that case, we should rendezvous with the Liebhofen, head for the castle,
and use it to intimidate them."
Ai: "But who's going to operate the Liebhofen?
We don't even know if there's a crew aboard, do we?"
Ymir: "That won't be a problem.
Several of the main crew should already be aboard
to get used to it."
Ai: "B-but! Even if we can get it moving,
there's no guarantee those enemies won't attack the castle in the meantime.
Besides, what legitimate unit would sneak
through a place like this?"
Ymir: "You both have a point, but...
What do you think, Touya?"
Let them pass
Attack
Ai: "What? You too?!"
Ymir: "Ai, let's go along with the others here.
Tyron is at the castle too.
He won't let the enemy get in so easily."
Ai: "...Fine!"
Ai: "Right? You've got pretty good judgment!"
Arthur: "That makes it two against two."
Clovis: "...There's no point arguing over this.
We'll be the ones to give in."
Ai: "How mature! You've got style, Clovis!
Way to go, Mr. President!"
Touya: "You... Are you really fifteen?"
Arthur: "Anyway, now that we've decided,
let's move in without delay..."

review_batches.context: Examined s_003 rows 0..184. Touya relives the airport bombing in a nightmare, wakes in the treatment room, and hears Ai's apology. Read through her shared bereavement and Yamato's survival before settling the initial exchanges.
review_batches.decisions: Dream narration stays first-person present. Restore ordinary English subjects/verbs, preserve deliberate broken thoughts and silence, and leave the warm objects and unfinished final vision unspecified. Preserve every FC:78:3E control. The parents' deaths are explicit terrorist-bombing deaths; Ai is apologizing to Touya, not asking him to apologize. Source line breaks retained.

row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o00050.l00: Two disoriented questions and trailing thoughts are intentional within the nightmare.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o00050.l01: Keep the dream's broken recognition of Mom; do not turn it into continuous exposition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o0027d.l00: Deliberate silent pause before the realization that no voice emerges.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o00289.l01: Comparison continues grammatically into row 24, matching the source split.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o00289.l03: Introductory comparison deliberately continues into row 26.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o00341.l04: Deliberately broken answer to the preceding claim that he should know.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o0039e.l02: Intentional narrated fragment describing the distance in a sequence of short perceptions.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o0039e.l03: Deliberately unfinished reaching thought before the flash.

row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o004bd.l01: Deliberate sensory fragment; do not identify the unmoving object.

row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o004ef.l03: Deliberately unfinished vision; preserve the FC control and conceal its content.
row_decisions.scenario.s_003.o004ef.l04: Deliberately unfinished description of the view; do not invent what fills it.
